Mrs McCarthy makes a surprise return to Kembleford and joins Father Brown to investigate one more murder.

Father Brown investigates when his old friend Sister Boniface is implicated in the murder of a renowned artist.
Birdwatching tourists are ruffled when they spy the body of a landowner who had hidden the nesting site of the rare Red Crossbills from them.
Detective Charlie Hudson teams up with what he calls his "highly trained law enforcement animal", a German Shepherd dog named Rex who he prefers to team up with because he doesn't talk his ear off.

Walter Veith answers pressing questions about the end times.

Donna Santos spent years rescuing animals, but that changed when her animals were terrorised by a malicious presence. Donna called in an animal intuitive and communicator to help.
Forrest sets off on a dangerous, shark-infested search for the extinct Caribbean monk seal. He and the crew come face-to-face with a giant tiger shark.

Features a cat that has too much catnip and knocks over the Christmas tree, a dog that ends up inside a toaster oven and a pet skunk that always gets her way.
Answering why it seems dogs know just how to get their human owners to do what they want, and highlighting the platypus, one of the earths strangest animals, with frog feet, duck bills, and more.

In dieser Sendung widmen sich die Münz-Experten von Reppa einer Form, die lange Zeit als Synonym für Standard-Investment stand, nämlich dem Barren. Doch mittlerweile gibt es ihn in Stückelungen und sogar als kostbar geprägte Sammler-Raritäten.
In der Sendung geht es um Gold als krisenfeste Wertanlage und Münzen als Sammelobjekte.

Der Druckereibesitzer Rudolf Sommerbauer wird im familieneigenen Wochenendhaus erstochen aufgefunden. Was erst wie ein bizarrer Selbstmord wirkt, entpuppt sich als lupenreiner Mord. Der Tote hinterlässt eine Ehefrau, die die Scheidung wollte, zwei Kinder, die sich ihr Leben lang von ihrem Vater unterdrückt gefühlt haben, und eine Geliebte, die er seinem Sohn ausgespannt hat.

Die Münzengalerie Reppa hat es sich zur Aufgabe gemacht, dem Thema Silber genauso viel Aufmerksamkeit zu schenken wie dem Gold. Die Münzengalerie Reppa-Silber Spezial ist deshalb ein Muss für jeden Sammler und solche, die es noch werden wollen.

Nach zehn Jahren kehrt Jérémie in seinen Heimatort im Südosten Frankreichs zurück, um an der Beerdigung des Dorfbäckers Jean-Pierre teilzunehmen. Als Teenager war Jérémie dessen Lehrling und vielleicht noch mehr. Von Vincent, dem latent gewalttätigen Sohn des Verstorbenen, wird Jérémie mit Argwohn empfangen, aber auch mit unterschwelligem Begehren. Kaiser Franz Josephs Liebesbeziehung mit "Sisi" ist legendär. Doch sie verstellt den Blick auf einen Herrscher, der mit eiserner Hand die Geschicke des Habsburger-Reichs lenkt. Fatale Fehlentscheidungen führen auch in den Ersten Weltkrieg.

Im Dezember 1936 verzichtet Edward VIII. für die geschiedene Amerikanerin Wallis Simpson auf den Thron und überlässt seinem Bruder George die Krone. Schon ein Jahr später sorgt er mit einem Besuch bei Hitler erneut für Schlagzeilen.

Auch nach dem Krieg findet der Konflikt der royalen Brüder kein Ende. Edward lebt im Exil und veröffentlicht kontrovers diskutierte Memoiren. Kurz darauf verschlechtert sich der Gesundheitszustand von König George VI. dramatisch.

Der ehemalige Outlaw Link Jones befindet sich zufällig an Bord eines Zuges, als dieser von Banditen überfallen wird. Er wird niedergeschlagen und zusammen mit der Saloon-Sängerin Billie und dem zwielichtigen Spieler Sam zurückgelassen. Gemeinsam suchen sie Zuflucht auf Links alter Farm, die seiner ehemaligen Gang als Unterschlupf dient. Links Onkel Dock Tobin will ihn dazu bringen, sich wieder der Bande anzuschließen, und Link muss einen Ausweg finden, um seine neuen Freunde zu retten.

May Pang war gerade Anfang 20, als Yoko Ono sie als ihre und John Lennons persönliche Assistentin einstellte. Bald verwendete die manipulative Yoko May als Schachfigur in ihrem Plan, ihren Ehemann zu überwachen und orchestrierte eine Beziehung zwischen den beiden. Doch daraus entwickelte sich eine echte Liebesbeziehung. Es ist eine zutiefst emotionale Reise, die Einblicke hinter die Kulissen der Musikszene der 1970er-Jahre und die dysfunktionale Ehe von John Lennon und Yoko Ono gibt.

In Florenz wurde das Konzept des Lebensmittelmarktes geboren. Vor mehr als 1.000 Jahren kamen die Bauern aus der Toskana ins Zentrum der Stadt und verkauften dort ihre Waren an die Handwerker, Kaufleute und Bankiers. Diese Tradition hat sich bis heute erhalten. Wenn man zwischen den unzähligen Ständen des Mercato Centrale in San Lorenzo, der sich in einem Labyrinth der mittelalterlichen Gassen befindet, umherwandert, kann man von den besten Lebensmitteln probieren, die die Toskana zu bieten hat.

Plötzlich ist nicht nur die Polizei hinter Whitney her, sondern auch das FBI, das ihn als einzigen Zeugen um jeden Preis beseitigen will.

After serving as an MSNBC contributor and guest-host on the network for four years, TV and radio personality Michael Smerconish believed he was ready to head a show of his own. CNN agreed, and thus was born `Smerconish', an hourlong Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Henry and Sam go to Hull to meet Mandy, whose late husband was an avid collector of classic motorbikes. There are several rare Vincents and Ariels on offer.

Tony Robinson delves into a pivotal day in the history of the modern world, examining the key events that made VE Day such a momentous 24 hours. From key moments such as the surrender of all German forces to the untold stories of soldiers tentatively stepping out of Prisoner of War camps into an era of peace, this is the definitive account of a day like no other.
Bruce is on a WWI treasure hunt, finding a mysterious soldier's medal from the Battle of the Somme. Plus, he finds the world's most expensive football.
Bruce heads to Ypres looking for items from WWI, finding a German trench mortar. He also goes for a ride in a WWI-era British tank - one of the first tanks ever used in combat.
Bruce splurges on a rare Sherman tank in Ohio. But before he flogs it he wants to boost its authenticity and value, so the twins consult a WWII tank veteran for advice.
Bruce is tasked with creating a display based on the French Resistance: a parachute basket filled with items the RAF would have dropped to the Resistance in WWII.

Hadrian's Villa is the largest Roman palace ever constructed and demonstrates the opulent peak of Rome's ancient engineering; experts investigate secrets that could reveal the truth behind one of Rome's most enigmatic emperors.

The legendary city of Kish, Iraq, lies at the cradle of human civilisation and home to some of the world's first kings; using cutting-edge tech, experts investigate the buried secrets of this lost city to uncover the first origins of royalty.

The clifftop ruins of Tintagel Castle are shrouded in a tumultuous history and believed to be the birthplace of King Arthur; experts use cutting-edge tech to unlock the secrets of this ancient structure and reveal the truth behind a legendary ruler.
French polisher Alex is challenged to rescue a settle bed. James gets to work restoring a Ms. Pac-Man arcade machine to its former glory, whilst Ted works on two weathered chairs.
Sculptor Nick is tasked with transforming a pair of headless garden ornaments into something worth looking at. Drew asks leather restorer Martin to breathe life back into an Avro Anson chair.
Lighting expert Jolene is challenged to restore an unusual Empire chandelier. James works on a Seeburg jukebox to bring back the music, and Ann-Marie is handed a damaged book to restore.
James Cracknell takes on one of the hottest, most extreme terrains in the world, as he investigates what the early pioneers of America's Gold Rush went through in pursuit of riches.
Mireya and Ronny return to where they heard whistles and saw glowing eyes. Meanwhile, Mireya agrees to be bait in order to lure out Bigfoot.
Russell records thermal imagery that he believes is Bigfoot. Mireya and Ronny have a terrifying experience when they realise they're not alone in the forest.
Justin and Emiliano scan the Florida landscape and dive in waters teeming with alligators as they try to unravel the mystery of the Mayan empire's fate.
Hidden messages in a 500-year-old map lead Justin and Emiliano to Florida and Arkansas in search of a source of water said to grant eternal life.
Ever wondered how a Lotus Evora is made? Join the How It's Made crew as they go to its birthplace and explore its gorgeous exterior.
Picture your dream car - does it look like a Bentley Mulsanne? The crew head to its birthplace, revealing the inner workings and gorgeous exterior.
Picture your dream car - does it look like a Chevrolet Camaro? The crew head to its birthplace, revealing the inner workings and gorgeous exterior.
Picture your dream car - does it look like a Porsche Panamera? The crew head to its birthplace, revealing the inner workings and gorgeous exterior.

Clayton Phipps and his team prepare to flip a 20,000-pound carnivore fossil out of the earth and onto a flatbed to get it to the lab for analysis. Meanwhile, Mike Harris hunts for a duckbill skull and Jared Hudson uncovers an ancient reptile.

Clayton must haul his 20,000-pound dinosaur fossil over 200 miles to a lab where it will finally be identified. The Harris/Bolan clan chases poachers off of their land and Jared makes a last-ditch effort to bring in some money this season.
Find out how vibrating mining screens, whoopie pies, wood utility poles, and roller conveyors are made.
Find out how exercise bikes, Cornish pasties, pasta makers, and slate products are made.
Find out how channel signs are created, wetsuits are manufactured, and aluminium aircraft are made.
More everyday items go under microscope. How are objects including aircraft cabinets and motorcycle brake locks produced?
Join the crew as they explore the origins, inner workings and technical specs of the Audi S8.
Picture your dream car - does it look like an Ultima Evolution? The crew go to its birthplace, revealing the inner workings and gorgeous exterior.
How do they weave a traditional Turkish carpet? How do they use helicopter blade technology to make cross country skis? How do they turn the water on and off at Niagara Falls?
The crew go to the birthplace of the Jaguar XF, revealing the inner workings and stunning exterior.
Kevin Delaney and his team of experts show how explosive hydrogen peroxide can really be. Plus, combining ping pong balls with pressurised liquid nitrogen.
Kevin and his team of experts explore the amazing science behind rockets, using unconventional materials to power homemade projectiles to incredible heights.
Kevin and the team take to the streets to create a massive, swirling fire tornado out of kerosene. They dazzle onlookers with a rainbow-coloured flamethrower.
Kevin and his team of experts use a race car to put a new twist on an old magic trick, and show what it takes to build a homemade hovercraft.

Confidential CIA files reveal a top-secret war for space between the US and the Soviets, and a team of experts investigates if new discoveries about American espionage during the Apollo program provide evidence of a conspiracy.
Experts investigate Apollo 11's lunar module that nearly killed Neil Armstrong during training. Some believe this proves why the moon landing is fake.
How are mountain bike suspensions, surgical sutures, grain dryers, and frying pans made?
See how downhill ski bindings, immersion parts washers, mining ventilation and pencil sharpeners are made.
See how gingerbread houses, livestock trailers, bottom-rolling hangar doors, and toy figurines are made.
The planning, design, and manufacturing process behind the creation of traffic signal poles, coffee filters, and chainsaw mining machines.

Jeremy Wade reveals details of a high-speed chase between a narco sub and the US Coast Guard; with the help of declassified files and cutting-edge military technology, experts investigate if they've found Pablo Escobar's lost treasure.
Clayton returns to his ranch in Montana to hunt for quick finds at Old Faithful. In Wyoming, Mike Harris and his team continue excavating their triceratops site hoping to uncover the valuable horns.

In Montana, Clayton Phipps prepares to learn if his carnivore skeleton belongs to a T. rex or the controversial Nanotyrannus. Meanwhile in Wyoming, Mike Harris and Aaron Bolan race against the impending winter digging at a promising new site.
In 1918, the SS Princess Sophia mysteriously sank near Juneau, Alaska. Experts look for answers to the shipwreck as a ghost hunter tries to contact her victims.

Henry and Sam have crossed the Irish Sea to search the sheds of Northern Ireland, and they find a vast collection of everything that they love. Will they be able to return to Oxfordshire with what they want?

Local racers in Idaho race off for $5,000 in cash, and when the competition heats up, some favourites are knocked out early. The last racer standing goes up against Damon for another $5,000, but a tricky racetrack makes for a rough end to the night.
Farmtruck and AZN find local racers to compete for $5,000 and the chance to go head-to-head with a Street Outlaw.

Las Vegas locals show off their stuff, and there are plenty of wheelies in Sin City. When one racer surprises the field, they get a chance to go up against Kayla Morton for another shot at a pile of cash. In a race like this, there are no safe bets.

Henry and Fuzz are at a farm in Gloucester looking through a collection of tractors. There, they unearth some historic items from the 1910s and '20s, but restoration may not be possible for all of them.
Chris and Francis install a 2.5 tonne traction motor, and head to the Highlands, revealing 37025's past and a family connection for Francis.
The day finally arrives when Chris and Francis attempt to start 025's engine, but after two years of silence there's no guarantee it'll work.
Chris, Francis and the team race to assemble their beloved 37025 before her main line test. Any failure will scupper their Highland dreams.
Trainspotting superstar Francis Bourgeois takes Chris Harris to the world's biggest train show to recruit him for the epic restoration of diesel royalty.
The duo have 48 hours to strip their locomotive for painting: cutting out rot, welding fresh metal, removing every window, handle and sign.

Henry and Sam set off down to Ray's shop to sell a bike, but while there, they discover that Ray has plenty for the boys to rummage around in. They have a wonderful day, but come away with less than they want.

The deal-searching duo are near Preston at Graham's place. They discover that Graham is also keen on military gear and Americana. In the end, though, Henry and Sam come away with something a little unusual and decide to put it to the test.

Henry and Sam are in the Lancashire countryside at John's garage, where they're surrounded by hundreds of trinkets. They encounter various military vehicles and treasures, and also a lovely old petrol pump.

Als Nicks Vater stirbt, fährt die Wohngemeinschaft nach Chicago, um Nick bei der Organisation der Trauerfeier zu unterstützen. Dabei lernen sie auch seine Familie kennen, die sich als recht unkonventionell herausstellt.

Neueste Produkte werden im Fernsehen für ein bequemes Einkaufserlebnis präsentiert. Von praktischen Haushaltshelfern und weichen Badetüchern bis hin zu vielseitigen Sportgeräten bietet das abwechslungsreiche Sortiment zahlreiche Angebote.
Mr. Bigby möchte seinen Hochzeitstag feiern. Die hilfreichen Helfer helfen bei der Organisation.

Die Ghul Girls haben einen großen Auftritt in Transsylvanien. Ausgerechnet jetzt verliert Vampirina ihre Stimme. Vampirina, Poppy und Bridget sind auf einem Schulausflug zu einem Spuk-Theater. Auf dem Weg treffen sie auf einen Geist.
Cat Burglar und ein Dieb wetteifern darum, eine Fahne zu klauen. Bitsy hat ein Mittel gegen Heimweh.
Bluey und seine Freunde spielen auf der Wiese. Sie dürfen nur die Schattenstellen berühren.

Bluey und Bingo spielen gemeinsam mit Papa im Garten. Plötzlich fällt Bingo ein wandelndes Blatt auf. Sie möchte es ihrem Papa zeigen. Doch dieser ist viel zu sehr mit dem Spiel beschäftigt und bemerkt sie deshalb nicht.

Die Familie hat Besuch und alle wollen gemeinsam grillen. Bingo hatte aber eigentlich vor, sich mal richtig schön zu entspannen. Doch die anderen Mädchen machen ihr einen Strich durch die Rechnung, da sie sich um den Salat kümmern muss.

Das Iron-Team muss Absorbing Man aufhalten, der eine Baseball-Pitching-Maschine stiehlt, um Chaos zu stiften. Amadeus plant eine Strandparty, aber Swarm taucht mit ihren Roboter-Krebsen auf und will das Iron-Quartier übernehmen.
Animated, Children, Adventure, Action, Comedy, Science fiction

Adrien ist traurig, weil der Todestag seiner Mutter ist. Seine Tante Amelie und sein Cousin sind gekommen. Auch seine Freunde wollen ihm zeigen, dass sie an ihn denken und nehmen Videobotschaften auf. Marinette gesteht ihm endlich ihre Gefühle.

Die Freundschaft zwischen Adrien und Marinette wird immer enger. Das passt Lila gar nicht in den Kram. Sie fasst einen Plan. Sie will Marinette das Leben zur Hölle machen und bringt schließlich alle ihre Freunde gegen sie auf.

Joe Gardner ist ein Musiklehrer in New York und träumt davon, als Jazzmusiker auf einer großen Bühne zu spielen. Als sich ihm eines Tages die langersehnte Gelegenheit bietet, mit der berühmten Dorothea Williams aufzutreten, baut er einen Unfall und landet in einer anderen Dimension. Dort wird seine Seele von seinem Körper getrennt. Er setzt alles daran, um wieder in seinen Körper auf der Erde zu gelangen, um den Auftritt nicht zu verpassen.

Der Waisenjunge Tarzan wächst in der abgelegenen afrikanischen Wildnis auf, aufgezogen von dem sanften Gorilla Kala. Als eine britische Expedition den Dschungel betritt, begegnet Tarzan der schönen Jane und erkennt, dass er wie sie ein Mensch ist. Tarzan verliebt sich in Jane und ist hin- und hergerissen zwischen dem Leben in der Zivilisation und dem Aufenthalt bei seiner Gorillafamilie, die von dem rücksichtslosen Jäger Clayton bedroht wird.
Movie, Animated, Children, Musical, Drama, Adventure

Mama muss Bluey eine allerletzte Geschichte vorlesen, da sie ansonsten nicht einschlafen kann. Ihre Geschichte wird allerdings von dem schrägen Gemeinhorn unterbrochen, das die nervigste Handpuppe auf der ganzen Welt ist.
Als sie Curry holen, müssen Bingo und Dad einer Elster trotzen, die ihr Nest beschützt.

Mama denkt, dass Bluey noch zu jung für Schach ist, als Papa versucht, ihr das Spiel beibringen zu wollen. Es dauert nicht lang, bis Bingo sich anschließt, woraufhin die Kinder ihre eigenen Regeln erfinden, doch kann Papa nicht immer verlieren.

Mama gönnt sich ihre wohlverdiente Pause und Papa spielt daher mit Bluey und Bingo Schafshund. Dies soll die Kinder davon abhalten, Mama bei ihrer Pause zu stören. Die Aufgabe entpuppt sich jedoch als schwieriger, als sie erwartet haben.
Die Eltern wollen ihre Hausarbeit erst beenden, wenn die Kinder aufhören, sich albern zu benehmen.

Luckys Vater ist empört darüber, dass das moderne Päckchenspiel ein Geschenk in jeder Lage hat. Er ändert deshalb die Regeln wieder, sodass es wie ursprünglich nur einen Preis in der Mitte gibt. Aber Bingo verliert immer.

Blueys Vatertagskarte soll perfekt werden, aber sie kann sich nicht entscheiden, was sie malen soll. Mama erinnert sie an all die spaßigen Momente, die sie mit ihrem Vater hatte und daran, dass er auch nicht perfekt ist.
Während er darauf wartet von der Schule abgeholt zu werden, gibt Jack vor ein Seemann zu sein.
Bluey und Bingo wollen mit Opa Restaurant spielen, aber das ist anders, als er es gewohnt ist.
Die Kinder spielen Café, aber Papa, der Chefkoch, scheint die Bestellung nie richtig hinzubekommen.

Als ein heftiger Sommerregen über das Haus der Heelers hereinbricht, ist Bluey fest entschlossen, das Wasser im Vorgarten aufzustauen. Währenddessen versucht ihre Mutter zu verhindern, dass ständig Dreck ins Haus getragen wird.
Bluey und Bingo backen Schlammpizzas und liefern sie dann an die Erwachsenen aus.
Bluey und Mum liefern sich ein Rennen gegen die Zeit, um Milch für einen Gast zu kaufen.

Bluey und Bingo sind genervt davon, immer zu hören, was sie zu tun haben. Somit beauftragen sie ihre riesige, unsichtbare Freundin damit, ihren Eltern zu zeigen, wer der Boss ist. Jetzt können sie tun und lassen, was sie wollen, bis sie rebellieren.

Adrien und Kagami sind auf einer Feier zu Ehren des 20-jährigen Hochzeitsjubiläums der Bourgeois. Aber sie wollen so schnell wie möglich weg. Marinette hilft ihnen dabei. Als sie bemerkt, wie gut Adrien und Kagami sich verstehen, geht sie.

Marinette hat einen Fehler begangen. Hawk Moth verwandelt Chloe deswegen zu Miracle Queen. Sie kontrolliert Wespen und bringt ganz Paris unter Kontrolle. Luka und Kagami helfen Adrien und Marinette zu entkommen, als es eng wird.

Yuna bringt Stitch zu dem Versprechen, dass er nie wieder lügt. Das wird zum Problem, als Yunas Freunde Stitch bitten, Yuna nichts von den Planungen für eine Überraschungsparty zu erzählen. Yuna und Stitch bereiten Taro auf die Schwarze-Gürtel-Prüfung vor. Als Reuben auf die Erde kommt, um Sandwichzutaten einzukaufen, entdeckt er Reisbällchen als Energiespender für Taro, der damit auch seine Prüfung besteht.

Grandma leidet unter Schmerzen. Yuna erfährt, dass es in den Zwillingshöhlen eine Blume gibt, die die Leiden lindern kann. Zusammen mit Kijimunaa begeben sich die Freunde auf die Suche und finden schließlich die heilende Blume.
Anime, Children, Science fiction, Adventure, Comedy

Yuna, Stitch und Kijimunaa machen sich gemeinsam auf den Weg ins Tal der Schatten. Sie wollen Engel aus den Fängen des gefürchteten Pilolo retten. Doch es wird alles nur halb so schlimm, wie die Freunde befürchtet hatten.
Anime, Children, Science fiction, Adventure, Comedy
Als die Greens ins Schwimmbad gehen, muss Cricket sich dem Sprung vom Sprungturm stellen. Tilly behauptet, dass ihre Ziege die Seele eines Hundes hat, und meldet sie bei einer Hundeshow an.
Bill bringt Gramma zum Arzt und lässt Cricket in Tillys Obhut. Cricket erfährt Bills Kindheitstraum.

Bluey hat einen eigenen Hinterhof-Zoo, in dem viele wundervolle Tiere leben. Besonders beliebt ist der große blaue Papa Gorilla. Doch der schnappt sich die Besucherin Bingo. Daraufhin muss die Zoowärterin Bluey das wilde Tier wieder einfangen.

Mama und Papa spielen mit Bluey und Bingo Rucksack-Touristen und tragen dabei die Kinder huckepack als Rucksäcke. Sie haben riesigen Spaß, Sehenswürdigkeiten zu besichtigen und das Essen, das auf der Straße angeboten wird, zu probieren.
Bluey und Chloe können jede Rolle spielen, die sie nur wollen, als sie sich ins Abenteuer stürzen.
Während sie Nachahmer spielen, findet Bluey einen verletzten Wellensittich.

Als Kim einem Panther gegenüber in Gegenwart des Zoowärters nicht den nötigen Respekt entgegenbringt, verwandelt Hawk Moth den Wärter in Animan, der die Gestalt jedes Tieres annehmen kann. Marinette wehrt Ninos Annäherungsversuche ab.

Als der Hypnotiseur Simon Grimault von seinem Idol Gabriel Agreste erniedrigt wird, nutzt Hawk Moth dessen Schmerz und verwandelt ihn in Simon Says, einen Spezialisten für Gedankenkontrolle. Er will sich an Gabriel rächen.

Der junge Inuit Kenai ist der jüngste von drei Brüdern. Eines Tages wird er von einem Bären angegriffen. In dem Versuch, ihn zu retten, stirbt sein Bruder Sitka. Kenai will ihn rächen und wird plötzlich selbst in einen Bären verwandelt. Er schließt Freundschaft mit dem verwaisten Grizzlyjungen Koda, der ihm zeigt, wie man als Bär überleben kann. Sein dritter Bruder ist den beiden jedoch auf der Spur, um wiederum Kenai zu rächen. Kenai lernt, was Freundschaft, Toleranz und Liebe bedeuten.

Percy Jackson wird beschuldigt, einen Mitschüler während eines Ausflugs angegriffen zu haben, woraufhin er von der Schule verwiesen wird. Infolgedessen offenbart seine Mutter Sally ihm zu Hause, dass er ein Halbgott ist und von Monstern gejagt wird.

Percy sucht im Camp Half-Blood Halt, während er mit dem Verschwinden seiner Mutter kämpft. Dort muss er zwischen Freunden und Feinden unterscheiden. Infolgedessen spielt er ein Spiel, das seine Herkunft und sein gefährliches Vermächtnis offenbart.

Brad geht in seinem neuen Job in einem Sportladen voll auf. Eigentlich als Nebenjob gedacht, entwickelt der Junge eine echte Leidenschaft für den Beruf. Tim und Jill hatten allerdings andere Zukunftspläne für ihren Sohn.

Ein Traum lässt Tim zu der Erkenntnis kommen, dass er eigentlich ein gutes Herz hat. Sogar sein früherer Freund Benny, mit dem er keinen Kontakt mehr hat, empfängt ihn in seinem Traum mit offenen Armen.

Jill hat von ihrem Erbe einen britischen Sportwagen gekauft. Tim ist darüber eigentlich auch sehr erfreut. Doch Jill hat dem fanatischen Autonarren verboten, damit zu fahren. Doch Tim kann nicht widerstehen und prompt gibt es Ärger.

Jills Schwestern kommen zu Besuch und bringen damit Tims Plan durcheinander, mit seinen Söhnen einen Campingausflug zu machen. Er ist der Überzeugung, dass Jill Familie eine wandelnde Neurose ist und wird auch dieses Mal wieder darin bestätigt.
Auf dem Weg zu einer Preisverleihung setzen bei der schwangeren Heidi die Wehen ein. Tim bleibt nichts anderes übrig, als sich als Geburtshelfer zu betätigen.
Al will aufgrund seiner Erfahrungen in der Heimwerkersendung ein eigenes Video herausbringen. Er bittet Tim, Regie zu führen. Doch ihre Vorstellungen stimmen nicht überein.

Micky versucht, Pluto aufzuheitern, indem er ebenfalls einen trichterförmigen Kratzschutz trägt. Der Kratzschutz versperrt ihm die Sicht. Micky gerät in Gefahr. Micky sucht mithilfe von Donald und Goofy nach einem Geist.

Ein Team von Weltklasse-Show-Wrestlern bietet den Fans zum ersten Mal seit 20 Jahren ein neues Wrestling-Erlebnis. Mit von der Partie sind Cody und Brandi Rhodes, Kenny Omega, Henker Adam Page, Chris Jericho und Jon Moxley.

Die Polizei jagt einen wegen bewaffneter Straftaten gesuchten Lieferwagenfahrer. Nachdem er gestoppt wurde, wehrt er sich weiter. Zudem löst die Entführung eines Jugendlichen durch drei bewaffnete Männer in St. Anne's einen Großeinsatz aus.

Die Zahl der Drogentoten in Northamptonshire steigt rapide, denn Gangs aus den Metropolen des Landes suchen nach neuen Absatzgebieten. Die Spezialeinheit Operation Revive vollstreckt einen Durchsuchungsbeschluss und muss schnell handeln.

David Duitser hat an der schönen Küste von Namibia eine Ladung Grillkohle abgeliefert. Jetzt hofft der Asphalt Cowboy im Hafen von Walvis Bay auf eine Rückladung, denn eine Leerfahrt hätte finanzielle Verluste zur Folge.

Der 53-jährige Auswanderer David Duitser muss in Namibia noch eine Tour fahren, bevor er sich auf den Rückweg zu seiner Familie in die Landeshauptstadt Windhoek macht. Aber ein winziger Nagel stellt den Zeitplan des Asphalt-Cowboys auf den Kopf.

Ein Paar aus der Ukraine wird am Flughafen El Prat kontrolliert und es erscheint verdächtig. Sie haben unzählige Stangen Zigaretten im Gepäck, was die Beamten sofort alarmiert. So viele braucht man nicht für ein romantisches Wochenende.

Die Tüftler müssen ihr Können unter Beweis stellen, als sie die Elektronik des K.I.T.T. nachbauen. Sie werden von Michael herausgefordert, der sich an einem Modell aus den 80er-Jahren versucht. Das Motto der Folge ist "Knight Rider".
Diese Sendung wirbt für verschiedene Produkte, die man sich bequem nach Hause schicken lassen kann.

Eine Mumie von König Nastasen in einem Sarkophag wäre eine sensationelle Entdeckung für die Forschung über das Kuschitische Reich. Sterbliche Überreste oder Grabbeigaben könnten neue Erkenntnisse über die Kultur und Religion der Kuschiten liefern.

Tierhäute werden nicht ausreichen, um sich in der Winterlandschaft vor der Kälte zu schützen. Die 3er-Teams müssen ein Feuer entzünden und ihren Unterschlupf abdichten, damit der eisige Wind nicht durch jede Ritze pfeift.

Die Bärenspuren in der Nähe des Lagers machen Ky und Gabby sichtlich nervös. Den Raubtieren geht man in der Wildnis besser aus dem Weg. Aber die Profis können sich auch nicht permanent verstecken, denn sie benötigen Feuerholz und Nahrung.

Ein 15 Kilometer langer Marsch führt die Teams in die Zone 2. Dort müssen sich die Männer und Frauen an eine andere Umgebung anpassen. In der Region liegt einer der größten Seen Zululands, und die Sumpfgebiete bieten Zugang zu neuen Ressourcen.

Am Fuße des Song-Shan-Berges sind in dieser Folge Kraft, Koordination und Beweglichkeit gefragt. Ed Stafford besucht dort einen Shaolin-Tempel, in dem Mönche junge Menschen mit uraltem Wissen auf den Übergang ins Erwachsenenalter vorbereiten.
Das Team nimmt ein Schiff unter die Lupe, das vor 20 Jahren während eines Sturms gesunken ist.

Das Team hat immer noch mit dem gesunkenen Schiff zu tun, das 500 Meter vom Strand entfernt liegt. Das Schiff hat sich auch nach 38 Stunden voller Schwerstarbeit noch keinen Zentimeter bewegt, weshalb ein neuer Ansatz gefunden werden muss.
In dieser Folge werden die spektakulärsten Rettungsaktionen noch einmal gezeigt.
Der Grenzpolizei wurde eine vorbestrafte Person gemeldet, die versucht, eine elektronische Fußfessel zu entfernen. Der Verdächtige will vermutlich das Land verlassen.

Claes und seine Kollegen kontrollieren am Stockholmer Flughafen zwei Reisende aus Estland. Der Grenzpolizei liegen konkrete Hinweise vor, dass die beiden Männer mit kriminellen Absichten ins Land gekommen sind.

Es herrscht Personalfluktuation im Klondike: Tony Beets hat sieben gute Mitarbeiter verloren. Die Goldgräber haben sich dafür entschieden, zu Parker Schnabel zu wechseln. Jetzt muss der Cousin Mike auf dem Eck-Abschnitt neue Leute einarbeiten.

Im Yukon wird sechs Monate im Jahr Gold geschürft. Danach schiebt Mutter Natur den Bemühungen der Schatzsucher mit Minustemperaturen einen Riegel vor. Aber unerschrockene Abenteurer versuchen ihr Glück auch an extremeren Orten. Von den Vulkanen Papua-Neuguineas bis zu den Gebirgsflüssen der Chilkat Mountains: Es wird der Weg nachgezeichnet, den das Edelmetall aus dem Erdinneren bis in die Täler zurücklegt, und gezeigt, welche Anstrengungen die Teams unternehmen, um die Schätze zu bergen.
Der Bundesstaat Oklahoma wird häufig von Tornados erwischt. Heute braut sich ein bedrohlicher Twister der Kategorie 3 nahe der Kleinstadt Arnett zusammen.

27. Juli 2025: Die Tornado-Saison ist in vollem Gange, und mehrere Sturmjäger-Teams sind einer Superzelle in South Dakota auf der Spur. Warme, feuchte Luft trifft heute auf eine Kaltfront - ideale Bedingungen für Tornados!

Das Castillo de Belmonte war Schauplatz blutiger Schlachten. Während der französischen Invasion ab 1807 diente es als Gefängnis, wo Hunderte Spanier gefoltert wurden. Einer, Tío Camuñas, startete einen Rachefeldzug gegen die Franzosen.
Italian professor Letizia feels no physical pain and has broken limbs with no discomfort. Filipino twins Charina and Chiara, 7, were born joined at the head.
In India, Arpit was born with his heart positioned on the outside of his rib cage. In Brazil, Winny suffers from a rare disorder that means her skin falls off.
At auction, Wayne works with a collector who has last-minute doubts about selling his collection. Plus, Wayne's 30 Ford Model A faces stiff competition.

Wayne and team are part of a multi-shop mission to return a coveted 1937 Bugatti to like-new condition and enter it in competition in the most prestigious exhibition in the world: the Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance.
Wayne buys the motorcycle of his dreams, an all-original 1928 Indian Scout 101. Plus, he finds homes for a 1977 Mercedes 450 and an Audi R8.

Dave and the team put the finishing touches on the first-ever Kindig CF Corvettes to complete a lifelong dream. The clients argue about who will get the first one, all in advance of a once-in-a-lifetime debut at SEMA.
Dave and Kevin make their return to the Specialty Equipment Market Association show after a year away. They have an ambitious plan of bringing 10 new builds to Las Vegas for the show.
A Beatles fanatic challenges Dave to paint a modern Rolls-Royce to match the car John Lennon commissioned in the late 1960s. Will the modern version be able to match the psychedelic original?

Dave and Kev take the show as far east as they have ever gone and head to Lake George, New York, for the Adirondack Nationals; the town shuts down for the car show, attracting some of the best on the east coast.

Richard and the Cogs restore a 1947 Delahaye and a Jaguar XK120 for Salon Privé. While Richard explores the future of motoring in a Bentley powered by synthetic fuels at Goodwood, a Lancia taken on to help leopards threatens to derail plans.
Anthony gets the chance to do driver training in a race-spec Nissan Skyline GTR at Donington Park, but his attempts to repeat the experience in The Smallest Cog's MGB end in spectacular failure.
The workshop is buzzing with activity, and the latest CF1 becomes a new challenge for the guys, while Dave makes changes to the original.
Scottsdale is about to witness one of the fiercest competitions at the last car show of the year; Dave gets all the help he needs with his toolbox.
International wildlife biologist Forrest Galante and Jessica Evans travel the world in search of rare and elusive wildlife, including those lost to science and mysterious cold-water sharks.
After the death of his father, a farmer believes he witnessed a UFO. A geologist uncovers debris at the Roswell crash site.

Tormented by childhood memories of abduction, a woman discovers an implant in her body. A sailor captures lights over the Pacific Ocean that he believes are alien craft, and a couple finds unusual footprints in the woods.
Declassified video captured by the U.S. Navy triggers Jess and Phil's investigation into mysterious, supersonic craft flying above -- and racing below -- the waters off California's Catalina Island.
Ed Stafford invites ultramarathon runner Matt Graham for a rematch after he was outrun by Matt at an event held in Mongolia's Gobi Desert.

Das Vorurteil lautet, alle Frauen, die bei einer Peepshow arbeiten, sind gequälte und ausgenutzte Menschen. Doch diese Dokumentation zeigt ein anderes Bild: Sie zeigt selbstbewusste und ausgelassene Frauen. Diese Damen haben Freude an ihrer Arbeit und können auch abseits von ihr nicht genug von der Macht über die Lust anderer bekommen. Sie lassen immer und überall gerne die Hüllen fallen und machen ihren Einfluss auf die Männerwelt dabei deutlich.
Im Reich des Königs Lustig, Napoleons Bruder Jerome, lag nahe Gießen an der Lahn ein altes Wirtshaus, Suzannes Besitz. Der Wirt der Goldenen Krone wollte es für seinen Sohn.

Die beiden Busfahrer Luc und Gaston haben ein Problem. Sie sind in dieselbe Frau verliebt und hoffen jeweils darauf, Marguerite für sich zu gewinnen. Dafür müssen Fahrgäste immer wieder Wartezeiten hinnehmen. Jedoch verpasst sogar Marguerite wegen der beiden ihre Anschlussverbindung. Die Busfahrer wollen aushelfen und fahren sie kurzentschlossen mit einem gestohlenen Bus zu ihrem Ziel. Dort kommt es zu einer Verwechslung und Luc wird verhaftet.

Die Sendung zeigt Musikvideos der deutschen Schlagerband Captain Cook, die auch englische Hits in deutscher Sprache covert. Der Erfolgshit der Band war das Lied "Rote Lippen soll man küssen", das im Original vom englischen Sänger Cliff Richard ist.

Susanne Berger ist eine begabte Trompetenspielerin und tritt abends regelmäßig mit ihrem Freund Walter Pfeil im Duett im Jazzkeller Heißes Pflaster auf. Gerne würde Musikfernsehredakteur Herbert Petunius sie entdecken, darf seiner Chefin jedoch nur männliche Künstler zuarbeiten. In der Bar erscheint Susannes Cousine Monika, die in einem kleinen bayrischen Dorf wohnt und sich zum ersten Mal in die Großstadt getraut hat.
In dieser Sendung wird das brandneue Henk-van-Daam-Wunschkonzert mit Maximilian Arland präsentiert.
Das Beste des legendären Schlager-Trios! Gute Sommer-Laune garantiert!

Ein Unbekannter taucht wie aus dem Nichts eines Tages auf dem Viehmarkt in Temesvar auf. Sein Name ist Sandor, der lang zurückerwartete Erbe von Schloss Barinkays. Im Schloss angekommen, sorgt der Erbe zunächst dafür, dass der arrogante Zsupan bekommt, was er verdient. Was dem jungen Mann nun noch fehlt, ist die Frau fürs Leben.

Die Tochter eines amerikanischen Modezaren, Rosemary, soll den ihr unbekannten deutschen Modeschöpfer Peter Hollmann heiraten. Ihr Vater erhofft sich dadurch geschäftliche Vorteile. Rosemary ist davon jedoch nur wenig begeistert, und als sie erfährt, dass Hollmann sie für ein verwöhntes Luxusobjekt hält, beschließt sie, ihm eine Lektion zu erteilen. Was sie jedoch nicht ahnt, ist, dass Hollmann sich indes als jemand anderes ausgegeben hat. Eine turbulente Verwechslung beginnt.

Was passiert, wenn eine eigentlich stockkonservative Familie auf dem Lande entdeckt, dass im Garten der Liebe die verschiedensten Früchte wachsen, die durchaus süß schmecken! Plötzlich kommt Leben in das verträumte Landgut. Und nicht nur am Tage! Die liebestolle Tante beweist, dass sie noch lange nicht zum alten Eisen gehört, und der schüchterne Patrick, sein cooler Bruder Julien und die hübsche Dina beweisen bisher nicht gekannten Lerneifer.

What do Britain's sharpest armchair critics think of this week's TV? Including: 'Gladiators', 'The White Lotus', 'The Apprentice', 'Celebrity Bear Hunt', 'Batch from Scratch: Cooking for Less' and 'Alan Titchmarsh's Underdog to Superdog'.
Fred and his team welcome more hopeful singletons to the First Dates restaurant, including Female-to-male transsexual Charlie, retired market trader Billy and single parent and 'true gentleman' Jake.

The First Dates restaurant opens its doors to more hopeful singletons from across the country, including eccentric theology student Louisa, barman Merlin, legal secretary Anna from Croydon and Junior, one of Birmingham's premier male strippers.

What do the Goggleboxers think of 'Celebrity Bear Hunt', 'The Apprentice' and 'Go Back to Where You Came From'? As well as 'Michael McIntyre's Big Show', 'Supermarket Own Brands: The Big Taste Test', and Channel 5 News (asteroid)?
Essex groom Gary plans an aquatic wedding 200 miles from home, but Lauren hopes for a home counties service. Will Gary's underwater dream sink without a trace?

Uncle Marvin reveals he has become a stockbroker and convinces Barry and his friends to invest their money with him; Beverly invites 50 people over for a Thanksgiving pot luck instead of cooking for the family.
An allegation shakes Abigail. A mother tries to get her son to open up. And as shockwaves ripple through the village, is this the end of Cindy and Imran's tragic love story?

The Dunphys stay in a cramped hotel room while the house is treated for mould, Gloria feels protective when Manny starts dating an older girl and Cameron wants to maintain his team's winning streak but fears Mitchell is a jinx.

Gordon travels to Pasadena, California to visit a Jamaican restaurant called Café Kingston. There, Gordon finds Dr Una Morris, a micromanaging owner who also works as a radiotherapist in a clinic next door to the restaurant. She is determined to use hospital techniques in her kitchen and is constantly sealing everything into plastic bags. Dr Morris is as stubborn as she is proud. Can Gordon help?

Gordon travels to Eagle Rock California, to visit Capri - a restaurant in a rut - owned by overgrown identical twins, Jim and Jeff. The twins could have walked straight out of Alice in Wonderland and their method of running a restaurant is just as fantastic. Half comedy act half cry-babies, Jim and Jeff seem oblivious to the grime and dust riddling their restaurant.

At Italian restaurant Firenze, the leadership's lacking, the pasta's a disaster and the chef can't even mash a potato. Owner Lew has had three heart attacks since he took over the restaurant. To top things off, Gordon finds a dead mouse on the floor.
Will arrives in California to stay with his wealthy relatives. Aunt Vivian tries to keep the peace between her startled husband Philip and their streetwise young nephew.
Will convinces Ashley to pawn her dreaded violin for a drum set.
Will wants to go out with a beautiful girl he meets at the country club, but first he must figure out how to impress her extremely snobbish and very protective father.
When Philip's parents visit from North Carolina, they embarrass him with stories of his poor rural background and his pet pig.
A shady character named 'Ice Tray', one of Will's friends from Philadelphia, comes to Bel-Air for a visit.

It's 'Free-From' Week! Gluten-free, dairy-free or vegan, the bakes might be free from a few things, but they're still filled with fun! With a place in the quarter-final up for grabs, the bakers show that free-from can still be full of flavour.
Homer decides he doesn't need church and forms his own religion.
Lisa wins second prize in a beauty contest. When the winner is miraculously hit by lightning Lisa takes over, only to find that one of her duties is being a spokesperson for a cigarette company.

The Simpsons throw a Halloween party where Lisa, Grampa and Bart each tell a scary story. A Krusty the Clown doll comes alive and terrorises Homer, Montgomery Burns travels to Skull Island to catch giant ape 'King Homer', and Bart accidentally wakes all the human dead in Springfield.

Homer and Marge go to the school parents' evening to hear the bad news about Bart's behaviour. While they're out Bart, breaks the babysitter's teeth and Homer vows never to let him see the new `Itchy and Scratchy' movie.
When Marge gets a job at Homer's work, Mr Burns falls madly in love with her. He invites Marge over for an intimate dinner for two, complete with a kidnapped Tom Jones to serenade them.
Homer believes his job is threatened by another employee, and Bart buys a factory with Milhouse for just $1.
Troy McClure hosts three spin-off stories from `The Simpsons' television show. Featuring the voice of the late Phil Hartman.

The combination of Homer, his new pet pig, and a leaky silo full of excrement triggers a disaster that threatens not just Springfield but the entire world. An angry mob descends on the Simpson home, splitting the family. With Earth's fate in the balance, Homer sets out on a quest for redemption in order to save the world and earn Marge's forgiveness.

Grab a dram and don your tartan as Scottish bakers from across the years celebrate Hogmanay. The bakers are tasked with making an old-fashioned dish in the Signature and shortbread in the Technical, before creating a cranachan in the Showstopper.
Young couple Peace and Q await twins after previous heartbreak. Maxine prepares for motherhood with her mum's support. And Hannah and Matt get ready to complete their blended family with a new baby.

Now that their final year of school is over, friends Will, Simon, Neil and Jay are off to Crete for a holiday. Hoping to get as much sun, sea and sex as possible, the boys quickly find more trouble than they had bargained for.
An extended edition with host Jimmy Carr and team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson. They are joined by celebrity guests Jo Brand, Nick Helm, Jordan from the Rizzle Kicks and Louis Walsh.
Jack Whitehall and Roisin Conaty join team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson, while Rob Beckett joins lexicographer Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner, and Joe Wilkinson assists Rachel Riley.
An extended edition of the comedy panel show with host Jimmy Carr, team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson, and guests Freddie Flintoff, Lorraine Kelly, Josh Widdicombe and Rob Beckett.
Sam wants a witchy wedding in the woods, but traditional bride Ezra has her heart set on a fairytale event. Sam's ghoulish gathering might turn out to be a real Halloween nightmare.
Fantasy fan Evan plans to wage war on his wedding, but his emotional bride-to-be Zoe wants a low-key affair. The question remains whether this noble groom will make his bride feel like a queen.
Fran and Rocky bought their tiny house before they had kids. However, now they have a toddler and another baby on the way, they need to find a new home fast and big enough for all four of them.

With growing daughters who need more space, Kim and Tim want to trade in their eclectic property for a new home. Determined to reveal the potential of the family's current space, Jonathan tackles the renovation, but hits a snag with the garden.
Anytime Fitness is a global firm, and it's the job of brand president Stacy Anderson to keep this gym giant in shape. Are all the employees on board with the planned changes?
In Leeds, the competition features a Pavarotti-style vocal performance, some home-cooked fare and fine dining, a problem preparing duck to order, and a mankini.
In Leicester, there's a menu inspired by luxury cruises, a moving musical performance that reduces one guest to tears, some outspoken comments and a serving of army-style 'banter'.
In 🏉 [Rugby] Rugby, party queens Soraya and Jodie's unusual pie horrifies super-confident Raj. And estate agent Michael and Caroline search for flaws in Raj and Freddie's 'perfect' relationship.

Gordon is in Atlanta, Georgia, to visit Michon's, a family-run smokehouse restaurant with a future that's about to go up in smoke because of mismanagement and lazy cooking. Michon's owner, Al Wilson, had always hoped that one day he would pass his beloved restaurant over to his daughter, Natalie. But when he suffered a collapsed lung, the handover came about much earlier than expected.

Gordon travels to Philadelphia to visit a Mexican restaurant called Zocalo. At one point, this restaurant played Cupid to a young couple who met, fell in love and married while working here together. Greg and Mary Russell loved the place so much that they pooled their resources and bought it. However, it seems that Cupid's arrow had a poisoned tip: the restaurant has become an albatross around their necks.

Gordon Ramsay travels to Fremont, California, to try to save a restaurant that is tearing the owners' marriage apart. Saki Kavouniaris took over the failing Spin-a-Yarn restaurant in 1995 and began to turn it into a success. He fell in love with a waitress, but the restaurant and the marriage are now failing.

Gordon visits Italian bistro Charlie's in La Verne, Southern California, which was bought in 2010 by Tatiana Leiva, her mother and her sister. Tatiana didn't actually put any money into the purchase herself, but her hard-working mother and sister did because they felt they were helping to fulfil Tatiana's dream. They even put up their houses as collateral! Unfortunately, soon Charlie's was in trouble.

Gordon Ramsay travels to Baltimore to try to turn around a restaurant that is suffering because its owner, Denise Whiting, has managed to alienate the surrounding community. When Denise opened Café Hon in 1992 it was a roaring success, but as a result of her unwavering business ambition the local community decided to boycott the restaurant, leaving Denise frustrated by falling sales.
It's the grand final and there's only one question left to be answered: how much leg hair does Alex Horne have? No, sorry: who is the 22nd Taskmaster champion?

Reginald D. Hunter and Aisling Bea join team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson, while Holly Walsh joins Countdown's resident lexicographer Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner, and Joe Wilkinson assists Rachel Riley.
Joe shares jokes, paintings and some of the trolling he's been up to, such as breaking into banks, selling art for 12.5 million pounds and taking on bronze medal winning Olympians.

Jimmy Carr is joined by team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson for an episode of the best bits from series 16. A host of well-known faces join the teams as they discuss the topical events that set the Great British public's chins wagging.

Coasts are the most changeable habitats of the ocean world, but they offer great riches. They bring great rewards but also great danger. Here, sea lions beach large tuna and moray eels crawl over land to catch their prey.

Uncovering the impact that modern lives are having on ocean creatures, from albatross parents feeding their chicks discarded plastic, to mother dolphins potentially exposing their calves to pollutants through contaminated milk.

Michael Portillo visits the self-governing Isle of Man, a paradise for rail lovers. He visits the Isle's ancient parliament, the Tynwald, which is older than Westminster, is taken down the east coast on the Isle of Man Steam Railway to the Norse castle of Rushen, test-drives the smallest production car ever made in Peel, joins a working fishing boat at Port St Mary, and meets two passionate advocates of the Manx language.

From the Isle of Man, Michael Portillo crosses the Irish Sea, bound for the mighty port of Liverpool and its historic waterfront. At the International Slavery Museum in Royal Albert Dock, he reflects on the city's part in the transatlantic trade in enslaved people. He takes Merseyrail to Birkenhead, where he inspects a German U-boat before seeing the underground room where the Battle of the Atlantic was monitored and controlled.

Michael Portillo continues his rail journey. He looks out across the vast and beautiful Morecambe Bay and joins one of the town's last shrimpers to learn how potted shrimp is made. At Arnside, he visits a quirky 17th-century garden at Levens Hall, helping to clip its vast topiaries into shape.

Michael Portillo is in Cumbria, enjoying one of the most spectacular coastal railway journeys in Britain. In Ulverston, he sets sail in a small craft with a lifelong devotee of Arthur Ransome's 'Swallows and Amazons'. At Barrow-in-Furness, Michael investigates the mountains of scrap left behind as iron ore was turned into ships, trains and railway tracks. From Silecroft, Michael hikes up Black Combe to join a champion endurance athlete as she navigates and runs across the fells.

Archaeologist Ben Robinson takes us to the quiet village of Ravenglass, tucked away on the edge of the Lake District's National Park, where he finds out about its strategic importance to the Roman Empire. Ben explores the village and its surrounding area to uncover the remarkable evidence of its Roman past: unearthing Roman pottery, locating the earthworks of its fort and marvelling at one the best surviving examples of a Roman military bathhouse anywhere in Britain.

David Attenborough travels to the ends of the earth on an extraordinary journey across the polar regions of our planet. The Arctic and Antarctic are the greatest and least known wildernesses of all - magical ice worlds inhabited by the most bizarre and hardy creatures on earth. At the North Pole, the sun returns after six months of darkness. A pair of courting polar bears reveal a surprisingly tender side.
After months of darkness the sun returns. The landscape is dynamically transformed and millions of migrants join the hardy residents as they find mates and begin to breed.
The desert town that faced a disaster of biblical proportions. Plus, vast coastal ruins that reveal a past once wiped from history.
As Hitler's shadow engulfs Europe, castles across the continent fall under Nazi control. Once symbols of nobility and culture, they are transformed to serve the ambitions of the Third Reich.
In 1942, a mysterious technology facilitated a deadly Blitz. Desperate for answers, British intelligence sets its sights on an installation in Bruneval, France.
As allied bombing raids escalate, a big concrete dome rises from the French countryside, reportedly concealing a crucial component of Hitler's plan.
After the Allied landing in Normandy, France falls city after city, but a small island fortress off the coast becomes the stage for a harrowing act of Nazi defiance.

As war rages between humanity and artificial intelligence forces, ex-special forces agent Joshua is recruited to find a person who has developed advanced artificial intelligence and a mystical weapon that could finally end the war.
Agents develop a revolutionary computer program that uses a digital child to catch online predators. However, the AI program begins to dangerously advance far beyond their imagination.

Sherlock Holmes saves noted Swiss physicist Franz Tobel from the Gestapo in Zurich and smuggles him to London. There, Tobel is reunited with his wife, Charlotte, to whom he gives a coded message in the event he disappears. Tobel presents the weapon he developed to government officials, and when he is subsequently abducted by arch-villain Professor Moriarty, Holmes and Dr. Watson risk their lives to find him.

Everyone knows that, each Christmas, Santa Claus delivers presents to every last child on Earth. It's up to Arthur, Santa's youngest son, to deliver a present to the forgotten tyke before Christmas morning dawns.

Three chefs compete in the heat for the central region. Returner Ryan Simson-Trotman, who failed to reach the national finals last year, is originally from Nuneaton and opened his own restaurant Orwells in the Oxfordshire countryside with his partner Liam, who is also a contestant in the North West region.

It is the fish course and the chefs are pulling out all the stops. Marianne pays tribute to the `angels' in her local hospital who looked after her during a recent illness, and Ryan's dish is a reference to the purported health benefits of fish high in omega 3 oils, while Sabrina is inspired by her aunt, a retired nurse who used to take in food to share with her fellow workers during her shifts.

The chefs cook their mains and, following the previous day's results, tension is high. Both Marianne and Ryan are cooking muntjac in the hope of impressing the veteran judge, while Sabrina is making an ambitious technical take on a family feast.

With one dish left to impress the veteran judge, the chefs cook their desserts. Marianne is looking to raise a smile with her 'carry on' themed dessert, complete with surprise presentation. Sabrina hopes to make it through with an elevated take on jelly and ice cream while Ryan goes all out with his very sweet treat 'A Spoonful of Sugar'.

The two remaining central region chefs do battle for a place in the national finals. They must impress the formidable panel of Andi Oliver, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton with their four-course menus.

Andrew is attempting to pay tribute to NHS staff with his take on a traditional healing recipe, 'Mum's Flu-Fighting Chicken Soup'. Jason's 'A Tea From The Heart' is a play on a post-war remedy which harks back to the era when the NHS was formed.

After the starter results, the chefs return to the kitchen hoping for high scores with their fish dishes. Chris once again is using ingredients he has foraged from around his restaurant, while Jason hopes to impress with a spicy scallop dish and Andrew prepares a cod dish with 11 different elements.

The chefs are pulling out all the stops in a bid for big scores with their mains. All three dishes pay tribute to the founder of the NHS Aneurin Bevan, Chris's 'Everything But The Squeal' is an ambitious pork sharing platter, while Jason's 'For The Rich And The Poor' showcases lamb, and Andrew is hoping to impress with 'Aneurin Bevan For Better Steak'.

It is the dessert course and the last opportunity for the chefs to impress. Chris is hoping to triumph with another dish which showcases the foraged ingredients available around his restaurant, while Jason attempts a technical feat in his dessert inspired by a childhood hospital stay and Andrew is inspired by a dish by his great-grandmother used to cook. Which two will make it through to the judging chamber?

It is the Wales regional final as the two remaining chefs do everything they can to impress the judging panel of Andi Oliver, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton. After tensions ran high in the week, the chefs are under pressure to deliver perfection. The judges are joined by Aneira Thomas, the first baby born on the NHS, who is named in tribute to the service's founder Aneurin Bevan and who went on to dedicate her life to the service. Who will win a place in the national finals?

It's the turn of three chefs representing the south-west, including two who have competed before but meet in the kitchen this week for the very first time. The chefs meet their surprise veteran judge and cook their celebratory starters.

It's the fish course and with Tom renowned as a fish specialist all eyes are on him. He's cooking his take on a classic British fish supper in tribute to a charity which looks after the health of local fishermen. Jude is attempting a complex fusion dish featuring four different fish and an unusual X-Ray themed presentation, while Olivia is paying tribute to the staff who looked after her during the birth of her first son with her take on curried monkfish.

It's the main course and two of the chefs are hoping duck will win the day. Tom is preparing a technically challenging duck dish steeped in NHS history while Jude is making a multi-element Chinese duck dish inspired by his mum. Olivia is hoping her dish, using two unusual cuts of beef, will score top points. Olivia also visits her local children's hospital, home of the second-busiest paediatric A&E in the country.

With just one more chance to impress their veteran judge, the chefs are all hoping to use their pastry skills to deliver technically complex desserts. Tom's cooking an 'Invalid Fruit Tart' inspired by a 1950s recipe, while Jude is making six different apple elements for his 'An Apple A Day'. Olivia is using stout in reference to an outdated old wives' tale which suggested the drink was a healthy source of iron during pregnancy.

It's time for the two remaining chefs representing the South West to go head-to-head as they cook their menus again for the exacting panel of Andi Oliver, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton. With a spot in the National Finals at stake, both are aiming for perfection as they bid for glory. The judges are joined by Barbara Childs, a Matron in the Cardiac Intensive Care Unit at Great Ormond Street Hospital, who isn't afraid to speak her mind in the chamber.

Three chefs take to the kitchen in a bid to represent the north-west in the national final. They include Ellis Barrie, from the award-winning Marram Grass in Anglesey, Liam Simpson-Trotman, an accomplished pastry chef and co-owner of the 4 AA rosette Orwell's in Oxfordshire, and Craig Sherrington, who sharpened his skills working under top names including Eric Chavot and is now Chef Patron of Virginia House in Cumbria.

It's the fish course and the chefs are all gunning for tens. Craig pays tribute to a friend who has revolutionised hospital food in Morecambe Bay, while Liam is inspired by health advice his grandma gave him and Ellis is dedicating his dish to the staff who delivered his son Albert. With cod, mackerel, shrimp and cockles on the menu, which of the chefs will score highly?

Time for the chefs to cook their mains and the pressure is on. Craig is hoping to impress using two cuts of Dexter beef, while Liam prepares his take on a Bajan lamb stew and Ellis prepares four cuts of suckling pig. Liam meets his personal hero, Nola Ishmael OBE, who became the UK's first ever black Director of Nursing.

It's the dessert course and the last chance for the North West chefs to impress in a bid to make it through to the regional final. Liam is cooking 'Not So Hot Toddy' in honour of a friend who works night shifts in the NHS, while Ellis' 'Worth Their Weight in Gold' is dedicated to the staff who saved his brother's life and Craig's dish 'The Missed Celebration' pays tribute to his wife with an unusual Christmas concept.

The two highest scoring chefs from the week return to cook their menus again. Judging them are Matthew Fort, Oliver Peyton and Andi Oliver who are joined by Dr Jake Dunning MBE, an infectious disease specialist who has been recognised for his work during the West Africa Ebola epidemic.

Three chefs are doing battle to represent Northern Ireland. Tommy Heaney, Head Chef at the Great House Hotel in South Wales, is taken on by Shauna Froydenlund, Chef Patron at Marcus Wareing's two Michelin starred restaurant, and James Devine, the 2017 National Chef of the Year.

After a tense starter course, the chefs return to the kitchen to cook their fish dishes. James is making his elevated take on a fried chicken takeaway as a tribute to the NHS staff who care for his sister. Shauna is also taking inspiration from a personal connection with a tribute to staff from a facility in her hometown of Londonderry. Tommy is hoping to impress with a dish dedicated to the discovery of DNA.

With two courses down it's time for the chefs to cook their main courses. It's the battle of beef with each using the same meat in their innovative creations. Tommy also meets the first baby ever born on the NHS.

It's the dessert course and the final chance for the chefs to impress. After such a tightly fought battle all week, each is hoping to deliver a technically perfect dessert. Tommy and James are both using passion fruit in their complex dishes while Shauna is hoping to use her pastry chef training to score full marks.

The two chefs representing Northern Ireland go head-to-head. Judging as ever are Oliver Peyton, Matthew Fort and Andi Oliver who are joined by Shehan Hettiaratchy, lead trauma surgeon at St Mary's Hospital who helped treat victims of the Grenfell Tower fire.

The winning chefs from all eight regions must battle it out for the honour of a spot on 2018's 'Feast To Say Thank You' banquet menu, celebrating 70 years of the NHS, one of Britain's most prized institutions.

The chefs must prepare fish courses, and after some exceptionally high-scoring dishes in the starter round, everyone is desperate to deliver perfection. Once again, the chefs present their innovative, witty and heart-warming creations.

It's main course day and with only two spots remaining on the banquet menu, the competition is fierce. Both chefs and judges alike are amazed at the high standard of cooking and an incredible number of 10s are dished out as the chefs serve up venison, rabbit, duck, beef, lamb and pork for scrutiny.

It's dessert day and with just one place remaining at the banquet feast, each chef is giving everything they've got for a chance to say thank you to the heroic NHS staff. All the chefs have significantly re-worked or re-invented their desserts since the regional heats, proving that they'll do everything they can in a bid for that final winning spot.

It's the grand finale as the winning chefs cook their dishes at a banquet for the heroes of the NHS. Having arrived at St Bartholomew's Hospital, the chefs are shown the incredible location for event, the almost three-hundred-year-old Great Hall.
Competing for the top spot are 3 new chefs to the competition representing some of the most exciting culinary talent from London, Paul Walsh, Luke Selby and Ben Marks.

The three chefs are halfway through their heat and the pressure is mounting. Only two will proceed to Friday's judging and have a chance to represent the London and the South East region at the regional finals.

The two remaining London chefs must cook their four-course menus again. The chefs need to impress the formidable judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge.

Three chefs new to the competition compete in the North East heats. Three of the region's chefs battle it out for the top spot: Mike Carr, Samira Effa, and Tom Anglesea. The three chefs must present the menu of their careers, inspired by 50 years of British pop music.

The chefs are halfway through their heat and will serve up their main courses and desserts. The stakes are high, and again they are each serving a unique take on the pop music brief.
